ModMetaData.name: Drum Bath Hygiene - Pickle removal check
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description: Development only, never published. It has no dependency on Drum Bath Hygiene on purpose: the launch that plays it runs with Drum Bath Hygiene and its test companion taken out of the mod list, and loads a game saved with Drum Bath Hygiene active, a colonist in the bath.
